text: This isn’t strictly speaking an impact TRACKING note, but maybe more of an impact-seeking or impact-planning note: <@U02LAK62DEV> we’re looking for ways to place one of Zhe’s stories in an English language publication with broader reach, like the Guardian. It’s about young people returning to Chinatown. I’m thinking, though, that it would also be worthwhile as a community service to have that piece translated into Chinese and try to get it republished by Wind Newspaper or another publication that is popular in Chinatown — to make a feature about a community more accessible within that community, rather than only promoting consumption by outsiders.
